styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: The Bund, Yu Garden and the old city lanes.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Soup dumplings, street snacks and long dinners.

styles.label: Shopping
styles.blurb: Nanjing Road, malls and the French Concession boutiques.

stays.why: Step out to the river skyline at night. Walk to Yu Garden and the old city. Metro lines nearby.
Central and well connected. Walk to Nanjing Road shopping and the Shanghai Museum.
Leafy streets, cafés and small shops. Good for slow evenings and food hunting.
Temple, malls and metro lines in one spot. Easy rides to most sights.

food: Try xiaolongbao (soup dumplings) and shengjianbao (pan-fried pork buns). Popular spots get busy; go early or expect a queue.
Street snacks are cheap and good: scallion pancakes, jianbing and skewers. Prices vary by stall; check on the day.
Book a table for dinner in the French Concession or Jing'an. Many small restaurants fill up on weekends.
Breakfast locally: soy milk, youtiao (fried dough sticks) and congee from neighborhood shops.
Drink bottled or boiled water. Tap water is not for drinking.
more_time: Add a half-day in Suzhou by high-speed train for classical gardens and canals. Book tickets ahead; check times on the day.
Spend an evening on the Huangpu ferry (about ¥2) for a cheap river crossing and skyline views.
Visit Zhujiajiao water town for canals and old bridges. Go on a weekday if you can.

recommend.why: Three nights covers the Bund, the old city, the French Concession and a good food day without rushing.

month_notes: Cold and damp: highs near 9°C, lows near 2°C. Pack a warm coat.
Still chilly, highs around 11°C. Fewer crowds at indoor sights.
Milder at 16°C highs. Good for walking; expect about 11 rain days.
Pleasant spring: highs near 20°C. One of the best months to visit.
Warm at 25°C. Rain picks up; carry an umbrella.
Hot and wet: highs 28°C, about 17 rain days. Plan indoor breaks.
Hottest month: highs 32°C, lows 25°C. Go out early or after dark.
Still hot at 32°C and humid. Stay hydrated.
Cooling to 28°C highs. Comfortable again; about 14 rain days.
Great month: highs near 23°C and only about 8 rain days.
Mild at 18°C highs. Good for sightseeing; about 10 rain days.
Cold again: highs near 11°C, lows near 3°C. Dress in layers.

climate_guide.summary: Humid subtropical: hot, wet summers and cool, damp winters. Spring and autumn are the best times to walk.

items.title: Best time: April and October
items.text: Highs around 20–23°C with moderate rain. Ideal for the Bund and long walks.

items.title: Summer is hot and humid
items.text: July and August hit 32°C with lows near 25–26°C. Plan indoor sights midday.

items.title: Rain peaks in June to September
items.text: Up to 18 rain days a month. Carry an umbrella and keep a backup indoor plan.

items.title: Winter is cold and damp
items.text: January highs near 9°C and lows near 2°C. A warm coat and layers help.

items.title: Humidity year-round
items.text: Summers feel sticky; winters feel raw. Breathable clothes in summer, layers in winter.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Comfortable walking shoes, an umbrella, and layers. Add sunscreen and a hat for summer.

transit.best: Metro for most trips: fast, cheap and English-signed.

modes.text: Fast, cheap and English-signed; fares run about ¥3-9. Buy a Shanghai Public Transportation Card or use the metro app for tap-and-go.
Buses cover gaps the metro misses; fares are about ¥2.
Taxis are metered; expect ¥200-500 to Pudong Airport and about ¥60-100 to Hongqiao. DiDi works well; Uber does not operate in mainland China.
Driving is not advised for visitors.
Walking and shared bikes suit short trips.
Ferries cross the Huangpu for about ¥2.
